'''Rejika''' is an [[NPC]] who appears during the daytime at {{Location|Teaching Zone}}.

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Rejika:''' Should I change my research focus...?
:'''Rejika:''' Professor [[Mornye]] has pretty much picked [[Exostrider]] Transitional Dynamics clean. There's nothing original left to write.

==Dialogue==
:'''Rejika:''' I-I can't even get a single paper published!
:'''Rejika:''' Maybe... I'll just apply to work with Professor Mornye.
:'''Rejika:''' If I can't publish on my own, I'll just do it under her.
:'''Rejika:''' Yeah, that's it! So now the issue is..."
:'''Rejika:''' If I remember right, the requirement to join Professor Mornye's team is to have published a paper on Transitional Dynamics.
{{Dialogue End}}
